prompt:
Use case: fur-material correction to a transparent desktop sprite of the real cat Odin lying ON HIS BACK, belly up. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and GEOMETRY ONLY reference: retain this exact low horizontal pose, camera, head on the right resting sideways on the floor, curled front paws together over the chest, bent rear paws on the left, tail on the left, face/eye identity, body proportions and head size. Its current synthetic fur is the part to REPLACE, not imitate. Images 2,3,4 are OWNER-APPROVED REAL ODIN PHOTOS of his belly fur, torso and legs; these are the primary coat-material references. Image 5 is the original approved sitting sprite: match its natural illustrated realism and contrast, not the current belly target's repeated wavy locks.
Primary correction: replace the decorative uniform rippling/wavy painted fur over belly, flanks, chest and tail with Odin's real natural coat: irregular hair grouping, varied lengths, mostly straight fine flowing hairs following anatomical growth, realistic overlapping fur at leg-body joins. Belly pale cream with loosely separated natural wisps and some varied tufts like the photos; NOT a repeating wave pattern, sculpted curls, knitted microfiber, etched crosshatching, scratchy procedural hair, plush airbrushing, smooth blurry paint or exaggerated contrast outlining every hair. Keep darker gray/silver unstriped flanks/torso and the dark fluffy tail, cream belly/ruff. Stripes only on the legs with natural facial markings; no new stripes or bands across the belly/torso. Preserve the face and compact pinnae with sparse delicate separated ear-tip hairs, not solid triangular spikes.
Keep this exact approved low side-view belly-up anatomy and horizontal silhouette. It lies on one FLAT invisible floor: support matches the flattened underside of the resting cheek on the right (approximately y=700 on the target canvas). Compress/bunch the lower back/flank and tail fur gently into that same horizontal plane, without cutting/cropping/erasing the bottom. Body, resting cheek, tail and ruff stay on/above it. ONLY paws may overhang. Tail-overhang exception applies to a different sleeping pose, not this belly-up one. No pose rotation, no higher three-quarter pose, no taller/rounder body. Preserve rounded paws and natural limb attachment.
Output one complete isolated cat, wide transparent PNG with genuine alpha, near target aspect ratio 1984x793, similar framing with comfortable transparent margins around full ears, whiskers and tail. No surface, drawn floor line, shadow, props, background, caption or UI. Do not crop the far-right ear or whiskers. This is the same image with corrected coat material, not a new pose.
